Football league
Kuwait Crown Prince Cup
Founded1994; 32 years ago (1994)
CountryKuwait
Number of clubs18
Current championsAl-Arabi (10th title)
Most championshipsKuwait
Al-Arabi (10 titles)
Current: 2026–27 Kuwait Crown Prince Cup

The Crown Prince Cup (Arabic: كأس ولي العهد) is a Kuwaiti annual football competition created in 1994.

Previous winners

[edit]
  • 1994: Kuwait
  • 1995: Kazma
  • 1996: Al-Arabi
  • 1997: Al-Arabi
  • 1998: Qadsia
  • 1999: Al-Arabi
  • 2000: Al-Arabi
  • 2001: Al-Salmiya

  • 2018–19: Kuwait
  • 2019–20: Kuwait

  • 2022–23: Al-Arabi
  • 2023–24: Abandoned
  • 2024–25: Kuwait
  • 2025–26: Al-Arabi
  • 2026–27: TBD
